scope: all 22 declared families plus supporting surfaces; bounded source comparison, not clause-level qualification

definitions.RETAIN: Keep base; no demonstrated donor gain requiring a change.
definitions.ADAPT: Translate the specific donor gain into the base owner and semantics.
definitions.CONDITIONAL_ADAPT: A proposed usability gain needs a discriminating matched case before inclusion.
definitions.BASE_REPAIR: Repair established base defect; do not credit it as a donor semantic feature.

rows.title: Frames and context
rows.retain_from_base: Claude frame ontology, ACT activation and acquisition ownership, separate authority and applicability.
rows.proposed_donor_value: Consider a compact application view over binding, support, preservation, authority, currentness and result. Adopt only if a matched task shows reduced acquisition without losing the owners.
rows.receiving_owner: REFERENCE_FRAME / ACTIVATION; view remains a projection
rows.compatibility_limit: Do not add a second deciding owner or copy Codex transformation terminology as a new mandatory layer. Admission-check predicate and admitted operation are distinct.
minimum_discriminating_cases: Known capability mismatch, unknown capability and missing assessment evidence must remain distinct.
A local frame fit cannot establish enclosing configuration fit.
rows.evidence_status: source comparison; prospective cases are not executed proof

rows.title: Transitions, steps and configuration

rows.receiving_owner: ACTIVATION owns admission and construction; REFERENCE_FRAME consumes
rows.compatibility_limit: No evidence that a wholesale TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY improves Claude structure. Preserve the complete enclosing obligation.
minimum_discriminating_cases: A locally valid step with a missing far-side dependency cannot authorize the dependent transition.
Unrelated authenticated evidence remains reusable when one dependency changes.
rows.evidence_status: source comparison; prospective cases are not executed proof

rows.title: Results and combination

minimum_discriminating_cases: A local write is reversed but a notification may have escaped: retain the external uncertainty.
A performed failure and an unperformed human check must not collapse into the same event.
rows.evidence_status: source comparison; prospective cases are not executed proof

minimum_discriminating_cases: Relax one failed requirement while another is unchanged; keep the old failure and reassess only the changed obligation.
Unchanged evidence is reusable only with its original scope and required independence.
rows.evidence_status: source comparison; prospective cases are not executed proof
